_note: The elements of every spell effect (scripts/vfx/spell_fx.gd). A spell SHAPE (projectile, beam, burst, shield, aura, slash) is built once; an element only recolours and re-textures it: three colours (core = the white-hot centre, body = the element's colour, edge = the dark falloff), its particle sprite, its motif and magic circle (assets/vfx/masks/<name>.png, greyscale), a glow strength and a sound family (assets/audio/synth/spell_<family>_<phase>.ogg, phases charge / release / impact / dissipate; a missing one falls back to arcane). A new element = a new entry here, no new effect work. 'mages': each mage's elements in the order she masters them - her spells use the last one she has mastered (progress.elements), else the first.
